scope: Corollary 11.2 (Fixed-gap weak approximate Nash hardness) of the manuscript “The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction” (preprints/The-PCP-for-PPAD-conjecture-a-quasilinear-reduction-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 136 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7ab4d86183890be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 130. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are fixed positive rational constants εw, δw and a fixed polynomial pw for which the following search problem is PPAD-hard under deterministic polynomial-time many-one search reductions. Given an explicitly encoded rational two-action polymatrix game of maximum degree at most three with the normalization above and complete binary length L, find a rational product profile of total encoding length at most pw(L) such that {i : regi(σ) > εw} ≤ ⌊δwn⌋. (11.1) No further regret bound is imposed on the players counted on the left.
